title: SectionViewStyle group-2 linetype handle overlay insertion
scope: Preserve typed plane/bend line-type edits when group-2 code-340 raw occurrences are absent
Exercise the second handle with a null first-slot placeholder
Verify reference closure, raw ordering, and typed same-version readback

production: The same-version overlay inserts missing plane/bend group-2 code-340 linetype references through the highest edited occurrence.
When only the bend reference is edited, the default/null plane handle is emitted as the first ordinal placeholder.
The null placeholder is allowed only for the unchanged default plane slot; DRW::NoHandle in an edited target slot remains refused.
tests: Generated ASCII and Binary controls remove both source references, set the plane handle to its null default, retain the bend linetype target, and export/read back the graph.
The focused control compares the complete ordered raw style stream, typed handles, and existing resource-reference closure.

limitations: This verifies generated same-version raw overlay and local handle closure only. It does not establish native-produced group order, cross-version serialization, rendering, or native CAD compatibility.
